tools.name: verify_answer
tools.description: Use this when: you have written facts about one notice (마감, 추정가격, 배정예산, 계약 방법, 낙찰하한율, 참가 지역, 필요한 면허) and want to check them before answering. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "verify_answer" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use this when: you have written facts about one notice (마감, 추정가격, 배정예산, 계약 방법, 낙찰하한율, 참가 지역, 필요한 면허) and want to check them before answering. Returns 맞음 / 틀림 / …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
